Subject: Short demo credit request during PO processing

Hi Emma,

Thanks for the procurement update — totally understand that internal approvals can push timelines out. To keep the pilot momentum going on your side (and make sure your engineers can complete the last integration tests), we can provision a one-time interim demo credit while the PO clears. Proposed terms: a 7-day sandbox credit (up to 10,000 tokens) with access to Redwood Standard models and no production data retention beyond 7 days.

If that works, please confirm (1) the list of users who should have access and (2) the expected PO clearance date. I’ll loop in Finance and Legal for a quick sign-off — I’ve attached a short terms stub for this temporary grant.

If procurement needs anything specific (data residency statement, low-touch addendum), tell me and I’ll escalate.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Emma Harris <emma.harris@solsticehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short demo credit request during PO processing

Thanks, Lukas — really appreciate the quick proposed fix. Procurement is estimating PO approval by Friday, July 16th (they moved some line items through legal this morning). A couple quick questions before we confirm users:

- Will the interim credit allow our integration team to hit the same endpoints and sample throughput we’ve been testing with (we need to run the 5000-req/day load test)?
- Can you confirm whether any request/response data will be stored outside of the 7-day window (our security team is sensitive to retention)?
- Procurement will ask for a written note that this is a temporary, non-billable grant and will be reconciled once the PO lands.

If you can confirm the three items above we’ll send over the access list (likely 4 engineers + 1 product manager).

—Emma
Emma Harris
Head of Applied AI | Solstice Health
emma.harris@solsticehealth.com
